critical_observations.dms_limitations: DMS statement conversion tool cannot handle multi-statement transaction blocks with T-SQL procedural logic (DECLARE, SET, BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT within single statement)
critical_observations.parameter_handling: DMS tool preserves parameter markers (e.g., @ProductId) in converted SQL. Application layer must handle parameter conversion to PostgreSQL positional ($1, $2) or named parameters.
critical_observations.transaction_handling: Transaction control (BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT) must be handled at application layer, not within SQL statements
critical_observations.returning_clause: PostgreSQL RETURNING clause is the preferred approach for getting identity values, replacing SQL Server's SCOPE_IDENTITY()
critical_observations.window_functions: All window functions (LAG, RANK, PERCENT_RANK, AVG/MIN/MAX OVER) are fully compatible and preserved by DMS
critical_observations.case_expressions: CASE expressions are fully compatible between SQL Server and PostgreSQL
